name: Apollo Cosmic
storyline: In the 1960's world governments classified many events at the highest levels, including certain events behind the space race and Project MK Ultra. Researchers have reconfigured the events of one of the most well guarded and "cosmic classified" secrets of these programs. You can now experience for yourself what happened to one of the subjects in this Psychological Thriller / Walking Simulator. Take a trip to the moon alongside an unwelcome tour guide. Listen to his words and decide if you should follow him, or find a different path.
summary: Discover the far side of the moon, the effects of participating in MK Ultra on yourself, in this psychological thriller. Find what mystery awaits above and below the moon's surface as you are joined by an unexpected tour guide who wants to help you find the right path.
